turns.text: Why does Agents: LLM-Driven Autonomous Systems deserve its own place in the history of artificial intelligence?

The key change in contemporary agentic AI is not tool use by itself. Large language models began to act as the cognitive center for goal decomposition, state interpretation, action selection, and self-correction.

That turns agents from systems dependent on hand-written planners into open software forms whose behavior strategies can be rebuilt through prompts, memory, toolchains, and feedback loops. It also explains why agent products expanded so quickly after 2023.
As today's systems grow larger, which lessons from Agents: LLM-Driven Autonomous Systems still matter, and which limits deserve to be questioned again?
